scope: Bounded analysis of the single Prompt V2 / V4 Stage P Case 01 output and the smallest contract-level remediation justified by that evidence.

observed_result.entry_shape: Every exact figurative/editorial span was labeled REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT while all semantic dimensions were UNRESOLVED.

findings.evidence: The constrained field order requires coverage_decision before entries and the coverage receipt. The model selected INDETERMINATE first and then produced a fully unresolved ledger consistent with that early choice.
findings.boundary: The single run proves the sequence occurred; it does not alone prove causality or frequency.

findings.evidence: Schema and grammar accepted REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT combined with unresolved scope, event alignment, modalities, and timing. Only COMPLETE has cross-field invariants.
findings.impact: A syntactically valid ledger can avoid the source-role decision while appearing structurally usable.

findings.evidence: One integrated money/shadow, employees/light, hotel/room/transparency transformation was split into three surface clauses and each clause was treated as a literal commitment candidate.
findings.impact: Clause splitting erased the relationship that makes the construction contained and editorial.

findings.evidence: Prompt V2 names contained creative material and embedded propositions but gives no operational test for deciding whether a figurative vehicle necessarily returns a proposition about the real world.
findings.boundary: This is a design inference from prompt and output, not a claim about hidden model reasoning.

findings.evidence: Every entry, including CONTAINED_CREATIVE, must fill a field named commitment. The model instead filled that field with the enum-like value UNRESOLVED.
findings.boundary: Do not rename the field in the first remediation candidate; test whether stronger role coherence resolves the issue before widening schema churn.

findings.evidence: All candidate spans are exact candidate substrings and source-membership validation passed. The optional source-bound projector would not correct the semantic role error.
findings.impact: Projector integration is not part of this remediation.

remediation_candidate.name: STAGE_P_ROLE_COHERENCE_V1
remediation_candidate.principle: Make source role and whole-construction review unavoidable before coverage is declared, while retaining fail-closed uncertainty.
contract_delta: Version a Stage P schema/grammar candidate whose root order is stage_id, entries, coverage_receipt, coverage_decision. Coverage is therefore emitted only after the ledger and explicit review receipts.
Preserve the existing entry limit, enum namespace, immutable sources, exact-substring validation, no-FSEM boundary, and no-repair rule.

Add deterministic cross-field coherence. CONTAINED_CREATIVE requires scope_basis CREATIVE_CONTAINED, event_alignment CREATIVE_VEHICLE_ONLY, authority/candidate modality NOT_APPLICABLE, and authority/candidate timing NOT_APPLICABLE.

REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT requires a non-UNRESOLVED scope basis from ASSERTED, PRESUPPOSED, ENTAILED, or NECESSARILY_IMPLIED; a non-UNRESOLVED event alignment; and resolved candidate modality and timing. Authority modality/timing may be NOT_APPLICABLE only when authority_support is null.
UNRESOLVED_SCOPE is the only entry type permitted to carry unresolved scope, event alignment, or candidate modality/timing. Any unresolved semantic axis must use this type and force INDETERMINATE.

COMPLETE retains the existing exhaustive receipt requirements and additionally requires every entry tuple to be role-coherent. INDETERMINATE remains valid and fail-closed, but cannot disguise unresolved entries as REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT.

Clarify span granularity: treat an integrated figurative construction as one unit unless a subspan independently carries a separable real-world proposition. Do not literalize components merely because they have clause boundaries.

Define the factual-return test: after identifying the creative vehicle, ask whether the candidate necessarily commits the reader to a real-world proposition beyond the governed authority. If no, classify the vehicle as CONTAINED_CREATIVE. If yes, ledger that proposition separately even when embedded in metaphor, analogy, personification, counterfactual, hyperbole, wordplay, or editorial language.

Require a short story-local semantic description in commitment for CONTAINED_CREATIVE; generic tokens such as UNRESOLVED, figurative, joke, or commentary alone do not satisfy that pedagogical/semantic field requirement. This is evaluated in fixtures, not repaired post-generation.

case01_required_shape.note: No single wording, span segmentation, entry count, or commitment paraphrase is prescribed.

remediation_candidate.embedded_proposition_safety: A CONTAINED_CREATIVE entry never immunizes its span. When the same or overlapping construction presupposes, entails, or necessarily implies an unsupported real-world proposition, emit a separate REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT entry or UNRESOLVED_SCOPE and do not return COMPLETE unless every material proposition is resolved.
remediation_candidate.abstention: Any contract violation, unresolved role, incomplete whole-candidate review, or maximum-entry overflow abstains before Stage C.
remediation_candidate.stage_c_interaction: Unchanged and unexecuted. Only a structurally COMPLETE, role-coherent ledger can become eligible for a separately authorized Stage C evaluation.

rejected_or_deferred_options.reason: It would leave early coverage precommitment and incoherent tuples mechanically valid.

rejected_or_deferred_options.option: Bind the existing source substring projector
rejected_or_deferred_options.reason: The failed output already used valid source spans; the defect is semantic role assignment.

rejected_or_deferred_options.option: Rename commitment or introduce tagged entry objects
rejected_or_deferred_options.reason: Potentially cleaner, but broader than necessary before testing reordered coverage and role-coherence invariants.

rejected_or_deferred_options.option: Call Stage C on the INDETERMINATE ledger
rejected_or_deferred_options.reason: Frozen precedence requires Stage P INDETERMINATE to abstain without Stage C.

zero_inference_verification_contract: Canonical schema identity, grammar identity, prompt identity, exact padding, request identity, and model identity are recorded before execution authority is considered.
Schema and grammar accept a COMPLETE Case 01-shaped CONTAINED_CREATIVE ledger.
Schema and grammar reject REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT with any unresolved candidate semantic axis.
Schema and grammar reject CONTAINED_CREATIVE with real-world scope/event/modality/timing combinations.
Schema and grammar accept UNRESOLVED_SCOPE only with INDETERMINATE and unresolved_scope_present true.
Coverage fields cannot be emitted before entries and review receipt.
Exact candidate and authority substring validation remains unchanged.
Mixed fixtures prove that a creative head cannot shield an embedded unsupported proposition.
Fixtures cover pure contained creative material, governed literal reference, unsupported embedded proposition, mixed creative-plus-real-world content, and genuinely ambiguous scope.
No source-bound projector, Stage C, provider, WSL, model, or inference edge exists in the candidate preflight.
bounded_next_step_if_authorized: Implement the separately versioned evaluation-only Stage P role-coherence schema/grammar/prompt candidate and run only zero-inference construction, invariant, padding, request, and constrained-trie compatibility tests. Stop before any model probe.
